title: Fix errors seen with check_typed_item_calls.py
description:
mpeg-descriptor:  Masks were wrong
atn-ulcs: Was trying to set 16-bit value into UINT8 field (while highlighting 1 byte)

notes.body:
added 1 commit
  • 7ea7439c - Fix errors seen with check_typed_item_calls.py
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/10341/diffs?diff_id=657026925&start_sha=27a68003365cc717958bc12f35e9380e9e92634a)

added 1 commit
  • 31552583 - Fix errors seen with check_typed_item_calls.py
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/10341/diffs?diff_id=657029765&start_sha=7ea7439c4cf05e56597d64f2583123a11572840c)

`epan/dissectors/packet-atn-ulcs.c` is a generated file, so `epan/dissectors/asn1/packet-atn-ulcs-template.c` needed to be changed (and `epan/dissectors/packet-atn-ulcs.c` then regenerated from the changed source), rather than being edited directly.

Fixed in !10351.

changes_data.diff:
@@ -2081,7 +2081,7 @@ dissect_atn_ulcs(
             1,
             value_ses_pres,
             "%s (0x%02x)",
-            val_to_str( value_ses_pres & ATN_SES_PRES_MASK , atn_pres_vals, "?"),
+            val_to_str_const( value_ses_pres & ATN_SES_PRES_MASK, atn_pres_vals, "?"),
             value_pres);
 
         /* PPDU errorcode in case of SRF/CPR */
@@ -2523,7 +2523,7 @@ void proto_register_atn_ulcs (void)
           HFILL}},
       { &hf_atn_pres_pdu_type,
         { "PDU type", "atn-ulcs.pres.pdu_type",
-          FT_UINT8,
+          FT_UINT16,
           BASE_HEX,
           NULL,
           ATN_SES_PRES_MASK,
